features.title: Headline cards and their numbers

Click each card (Total Leads, Customer Replied, Messages Delivered, Dealer Action Required, Appointments made / for today / showed / sold).
features.expect: Each card's number changes with the dates; clicking a card opens the Leads (or Appointments / Tasks) page filtered to exactly those records, in the same tab; Back returns to the Dashboard; the list count equals the card number.

features.title: Date range picker
features.about: A component of its own: Today, Yesterday, This week, This month, Last month, custom range.
steps: Pick each preset, then a custom range of two days.
features.expect: The label shows the picked range; every card and chart reloads for it; the range survives a page refresh.

features.expect: The message appears in the conversation tagged as staff; it reaches your test phone / inbox; it is written in the customer's language.

features.title: Edit lead (saves by itself)

features.expect: Each change saves without a Save button and shows in the other browser within about 30 seconds; the change is in the lead's history.

features.title: Actions menu: Add lead, Import CSV, Export CSV, Select leads, Bulk history
steps: Actions → Add lead: fill a test lead (pick Lead Source; try Edit list), save.
